Define Functions:
```{r}
temporal_encoding <- function(data) {
  # Convert Time column to Date-Time format and create temporal features
   data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      Time = parse_date_time(Time, orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd H", "ymd")),
      Hour = factor(hour(Time)),
      Minute = factor(minute(Time)),
      Weekday = factor(wday(Time, label = TRUE)),
      DayofMonth = factor(mday(Time)),
      WeekofMonth = factor(ceiling(day(Time) / 7)),
      Month = factor(month(Time, label = TRUE))
    ) %>%
    arrange(Time)

  # Add lagged residuals for 1–4 weeks
  for (week in 1:4) {
    lag_label <- paste0("Lag_", week, "_Week")
    lag_time_col <- paste0("LagTime_", week, "_Week")

    data <- data %>%
      mutate(!!lag_time_col := Time - weeks(week)) %>%
      left_join(
        data %>%
          select(Time, .resid) %>%
          rename(!!lag_label := .resid),
        by = setNames("Time", lag_time_col)
      ) %>%
      select(-all_of(lag_time_col))
  }

  # Fill NAs in all lag columns with previous value
  data <- data %>%
    arrange(Time) %>%
    fill(starts_with("Lag_"), .direction = "down")

  return(data)
}

# process_data converts a random df into a format usable by Tree Alert!
process_data <- function(data, time_col, actual_col, forecast_col) {

  data %>%
    # Select specified columns and rename them
    dplyr::select({{ time_col }}, {{ actual_col }}, {{ forecast_col }}) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      Time = {{ time_col }},         # Rename timestamp
      actual = {{ actual_col }},     # Rename actual load
      forecast = {{ forecast_col }}  # Rename forecast load
    ) %>%
    # Convert to datetime and handle multiple possible formats
    dplyr::mutate(
      Time = parse_date_time(Time, orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "dmy HMS", "dmy HM")),
      .resid = actual - forecast     # Calculate forecast error
    ) %>%
    na.omit()                        # Remove any NA values
}

# To generate geom_point layers for 'All Filters Actual Vs Predicted'
add_fitted_points_func <- function(data_list, color_list, shape_values) {
  layers <- lapply(seq_along(data_list), function(i) {
    geom_point(data = data_list[[i]], 
               aes(x = Time, y = Value, shape = .resid >= top_5_percent_value | .resid <= bottom_5_percent_value),
               size = 2.5, stroke = 1, color = color_list[i])
  })
  return(layers)
}

# To generate geom_point layers for 'All Filters Residuals'
add_resid_points_func <- function(data_list, color_list, shape_values) {
  layers <- lapply(seq_along(data_list), function(i) {
    geom_point(data = data_list[[i]], 
               aes(x = Time, y = .resid, shape = .resid >= top_5_percent_value | 
                     .resid <= bottom_5_percent_value),
               size = 2.5, stroke = 1, color = color_list[i])
  })
  return(layers)
}

# Function to create the plot for a specific month
create_monthly_plot <- function(data, start_date, end_date) {
  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Time)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Value, color = "Actual"), show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_line(aes(y = model_1, color = "Fitted"), alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
    # changed to skip rules 1-2 
    add_fitted_points_func(list_of_dfs[start_row:length(list_of_dfs)], 
                       color_string[start_row:length(list_of_dfs)], 
                       c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 16))
    #add_fitted_points_func(list_of_dfs, color_string, # make geom_point layers
    #                                  c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 16)) + 
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 16)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Actual" = "#4682B4", "Fitted" = "#FF8C00")) +
    scale_x_datetime(limits = as.POSIXct(c(start_date, end_date)), 
                     date_labels = "%m-%d",
                     #date_breaks = "3 days",
                     expand = c(0.02, 0.02)) +
    labs(title = paste(""), x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Variable") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_markdown(size = 10),
          plot.title.position = "panel")
  
  return(plot)
}
```

# Make Trees & Pull Rules
#update CP and minibucket here!

```{r}
#------------Regression tree on .resid + temporal variables------------
tree_model <- rpart(.resid ~ Minute + Hour + Weekday ,
                    data = train_set, method = "anova", 
                    cp = 0.0000, minbucket = 5)
# cp = 0.000, minbucket = 3
# cp = 0.00006, minbucket = 2
# + DayofMonth+ WeekofMonth, + Lag_2_Week + Minute +
tree_rules <- rpart.rules(tree_model, cover = FALSE, digits = 4, nn = FALSE)
```

Attached the predicted tree nodes to DF and pull top 10 rules
```{r}
#------------Maps leafs to Observations------------
# Predict the leaf node for each observation
leaf_nodes <- predict(tree_model, newdata = data_df, type = "vector")
# Combine the leaf nodes with the original dataset
heart_merged_with_leaf <- dplyr::bind_cols(data_df, Leaf_Node = leaf_nodes)

# ------------Pull top 3 positive and top 3 negative rules------------
rule_selection <- tree_alert_select_positive_negative_rules(
  tree_rules = tree_rules,
  n_positive = 3,
  n_negative = 3
)
selected_rules <- rule_selection$selected_rules

# Create list of residuals
top_resid_list <- rule_selection$rule_values

# For rule texts, track row indices
selected_rule_rows <- rule_selection$rule_rows

# Update start and end indices for loop
start_row <- 1
end_row <- length(top_resid_list)  # should be 6

```

# THE PROGRAM -- appllies rules as filter and plot results
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
#------------Filter the rows for each rule for plotting------------
last_column_index <- length(top_resid_list)

# helper to clean the rule text coming from rpart.rules()
format_rule_text <- function(rule_row) {
  tokens <- as.character(unlist(rule_row, use.names = FALSE))
  tokens <- tokens[!is.na(tokens) & nzchar(tokens)]
  # drop enumerator tokens like ".1", ".2", ...
  tokens <- tokens[!grepl("^\\.[0-9]+$", tokens)]
  txt <- paste(tokens, collapse = " ")
  txt <- gsub("\\s*&\\s*", " & ", txt)      # spacing around &
  txt <- gsub("\\s{2,}", " ", txt)          # collapse extra spaces
  txt <- sub("^\\.resid\\s*", "", txt)      # remove ".resid" label but keep value
  trimws(txt)
}

list_of_dfs <- list()
for (i in start_row:end_row) {
  # map to the correct row in tree_rules for the selected rule
  sel_idx <- selected_rule_rows[i]

  current_rule <- as.numeric(top_resid_list[[i]])
  precision <- 2

  filtered_data <- heart_merged_with_leaf %>%
    dplyr::filter(round(Leaf_Node, precision) == round(current_rule, precision))

  # build clean rule text from the selected row (not the i-th original row)
  first_row <- tree_rules[sel_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  constructed_sentence <- format_rule_text(first_row)

  rule_text <- grid::textGrob(
    paste0("Rule ", i, "\n", constructed_sentence),
    gp = grid::gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 9)
  )

  print(constructed_sentence)

  # plots
  post_rules_scatter_plot <- ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = Time, y = .resid)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = .resid > 10)) +
    geom_text(aes(label = format(Time, "%H:%M")), hjust = -0.1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2) +
    labs(title = "Scatter Plot Highlighted of Residuals", x = "Time", y = "Residual") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#FF0000", "TRUE" = "#9400D3")) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 2))

  list_of_dfs[[i]] <- filtered_data

  post_rules_line_plot <- ggplot(data_df, aes(x = Time, y = .resid)) +
    geom_line(color = "#00BFC4") +
    geom_point(
      data = filtered_data,
      aes(
        x = Time, y = .resid,
        color = .resid >= top_5_percent_value | .resid <= bottom_5_percent_value,
        shape = .resid >= top_5_percent_value | .resid <= bottom_5_percent_value
      ),
      size = 2.5, stroke = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = color_string[i], "TRUE" = color_string[i])) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 16)) +
    labs(title = "Residual Plot with Tree Filtered Extreme and Non-extreme Values", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_markdown())

  actual_predicted_plot <- ggplot(data_df, aes(x = Time)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Value, color = "Actual"), show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(
      data = filtered_data,
      aes(
        x = Time, y = Value,
        shape = .resid >= top_5_percent_value | .resid <= bottom_5_percent_value,
        color = .resid >= top_5_percent_value | .resid <= bottom_5_percent_value
      ),
      size = 2.5, stroke = 1, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = color_string[i],
                                  "FALSE" = color_string[i], 
                                  "Actual" = "#4682B4"), guide = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 1, "FALSE" = 16)) +
    labs(title = "<span style='color:#4682B4'><b>Actual</b></span> Electricity Demand + Tree Filtered Points",
         x = NULL, y = NULL, color = "Variable") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "none", plot.title = element_markdown())

  grid.arrange(rule_text, post_rules_scatter_plot, ncol = 1)
  grid.arrange(post_rules_line_plot, actual_predicted_plot, ncol = 1, heights = c(10, 10))
}
```
